a260905p1.summary: The downround, which marks a nearly 70% correction from Slice's earlier valuation, comes after funding talks with Accel …
a260905p1.title: Sources: India-based Slice, which has transitioned from a credit card-led fintech to a small finance bank, raised $100M at a ~$450M valuation, down from ~$1.4B (Moneycontrol)

a260905p2.summary: The financing includes a $90 million Series C equity round and $130 million in debt facilities.
a260905p2.title: Scan.com, which uses AI to match patient referrals with imaging centers by availability, price, and specialty, raised a $220M Series C, including $90M in equity (Eve Bender/MobiHealthNews)

a260905p3.summary: The United States and United Kingdom will work together on an initiative to shut down scam centers stealing billions of dollars through investment and romance fraud schemes.
a260905p3.title: The US and UK sign an MOU to investigate and share info on organized crime syndicates behind online scam centers, many of which are based in Southeast Asia (Jonathan Greig/The Record)

a260905p4.summary: A clever technique used to hide malicious prompts in attacks on AI agents has been adopted by spammers to evade filters …
a260905p4.title: Microsoft says email spammers are adopting ASCII smuggling, an AI prompt injection tactic used to hide malicious instructions, to evade email platform filters (Dan Goodin/Ars Technica)

a260905p5.summary: John Borthwick's venture firm wrote the first check Hugging Face ever received, and now owns a stake that could be worth $650 million.
a260905p5.title: Source: Betaworks has a 5.5% stake in Hugging Face, worth ~$650M at its $11.9B acquisition price for stockholders; A.Capital says it could bag $1.5B on the sale (Yuliya Chernova/Wall Street Journal)

a260905p6.summary: Chinese AI companies are rapidly closing the gap with US rivals, even after years of restrictions on their access to advanced chips.
a260905p6.title: Q&A with Kai-Fu Lee on China's open-model advantage, AI's impact on jobs, US export restrictions on chips, Chinese AI's role in developing countries, and more (Mishal Husain/Bloomberg)

a260905p7.summary: How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it's past time for us …
a260905p7.title: In response to the "wiki incident", OpenAI says it is working on a framework for reporting misalignment incidents during training, evaluation, and deployment (@openai)
